item_short_desc: Embrace outdoor comfort with Rothco's U.S. Made Wool Blanket. Crafted from 70% Virgin Wool, this 62 inch x 80 inch blanket ensures superior warmth and natural fire retardancy. Ideal for camping, backpacking, and survival readiness, proudly made in the USA.
